phases.label: WARM-UP WALK
phases.instruction: Walk now for five minutes at a comfortable warm-up pace.
phases.cue: Stand tall, relax your shoulders, and gradually walk more briskly.
phases.warning: Ten seconds remaining. Prepare for an easy run.
phases.encouragement: You should feel warmer, not tired.
phases.completionInstruction: Start round one at an easy, conversational pace.

phases.label: EASY RUN
phases.instruction: Run now for one minute at an easy, conversational pace.
phases.cue: Keep your stride short and relaxed. Do not sprint.
phases.warning: Ten seconds remaining. Prepare to walk.
phases.encouragement: Stay relaxed enough to speak in short sentences.
phases.completionInstruction: Change to a brisk recovery walk.

phases.label: RECOVERY WALK
phases.instruction: Walk now for two minutes at a brisk recovery pace.
phases.cue: Keep moving and let your breathing settle.
phases.warning: Ten seconds remaining. Prepare for round two.
phases.encouragement: Walk tall and keep the effort comfortable.
phases.completionInstruction: Start round two at an easy, conversational pace.

phases.label: EASY RUN
phases.instruction: Run now for one minute at an easy, conversational pace.
phases.cue: Relax your shoulders and hands. Do not sprint.
phases.warning: Ten seconds remaining. Prepare to walk.
phases.encouragement: Keep the effort smooth and controlled.
phases.completionInstruction: Change to a brisk recovery walk.

phases.label: RECOVERY WALK
phases.instruction: Walk now for two minutes at a brisk recovery pace.
phases.warning: Ten seconds remaining. Prepare for round three.
phases.encouragement: Keep moving while your breathing settles.
phases.completionInstruction: Start round three at an easy, conversational pace.

phases.label: EASY RUN
phases.instruction: Run now for one minute at an easy, conversational pace.
phases.cue: Use a short stride and quiet effort. Do not sprint.
phases.warning: Ten seconds remaining. Prepare to walk.
phases.encouragement: Stay controlled as you approach halfway.
phases.completionInstruction: Change to a brisk recovery walk.

phases.label: RECOVERY WALK
phases.instruction: Walk now for two minutes at a brisk recovery pace.
phases.cue: Keep moving and let your breathing settle.
phases.warning: Ten seconds remaining. Prepare for round four.
phases.encouragement: Half the running rounds are complete.
phases.completionInstruction: Start round four at an easy, conversational pace.

phases.label: EASY RUN
phases.instruction: Run now for one minute at an easy, conversational pace.
phases.cue: Keep your rhythm controlled. Do not sprint.
phases.warning: Ten seconds remaining. Prepare to walk.
phases.completionInstruction: Change to a brisk recovery walk.

phases.label: RECOVERY WALK
phases.instruction: Walk now for two minutes at a brisk recovery pace.
phases.cue: Continue forward while your breathing settles.
phases.warning: Ten seconds remaining. Prepare for round five.
phases.completionInstruction: Start round five at an easy, conversational pace.

phases.label: EASY RUN
phases.instruction: Run now for one minute at an easy, conversational pace.
phases.cue: Relax your jaw, shoulders, and hands. Do not sprint.
phases.warning: Ten seconds remaining. Prepare to walk.
phases.encouragement: Keep enough control to speak in short sentences.
phases.completionInstruction: Change to a brisk recovery walk.

phases.label: RECOVERY WALK
phases.instruction: Walk now for two minutes at a brisk recovery pace.
phases.warning: Ten seconds remaining. Prepare for the final run.
phases.completionInstruction: Start the final run at an easy, conversational pace.

phases.label: FINAL EASY RUN
phases.instruction: Run now for one minute at an easy, conversational pace.
phases.cue: Stay controlled. Do not sprint the finish.
phases.warning: Ten seconds remaining. Prepare to walk.
phases.encouragement: Finish relaxed, with the same short stride.
phases.completionInstruction: Change to the final brisk recovery walk.

phases.label: FINAL RECOVERY WALK
phases.instruction: Walk now for two minutes at a brisk recovery pace.
phases.cue: Keep moving and let your breathing settle.
phases.warning: Ten seconds remaining. Prepare for the cool-down.
phases.encouragement: All six running rounds are complete.
phases.completionInstruction: Ease into a comfortable cool-down walk.

phases.label: COOL-DOWN WALK
phases.instruction: Walk now for five minutes at an easy cool-down pace.
phases.cue: Gradually slow down and let your breathing return towards normal.
phases.warning: Ten seconds remaining. Keep walking easily.
phases.completionInstruction: Session complete. Continue walking until you feel settled.
